toolStatus._doc: Tools shelf recommends/wires must stay ACTIVE. status:active = healthy; status:archived = EOL → must NOT be recommended (the P-39 class). The loop flags any tool whose status is 'archived' as drift (a recommended tool went dead). bucket-antivirus-function is the canonical archived example — it is recorded archived ON PURPOSE so shelf never recommends it; if any ACTIVE-listed tool flips to archived, that is the drift to catch.
